g.text: How often does a task contain a selection error?

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4f5963

g.text: Cell values are percentages of 100 planned tasks, not recall or precision.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4f5963

g.text: K1: disconnected distractors; K2: adjacent distractors. All references contain six nodes.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4f5963

g.text: A mixed-error task appears in both panels. Invalid outcomes stay in the denominator and are not labelled FN/FP.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4f5963

g.text: Source: saved Core outcome counts. Descriptive proportions; no new model calls or uncertainty tests.
